title: Bill of Materials from federated Revit models

levels.BOM: required material and product quantities (this standard)
levels.procurement_BOM: what is ordered (GC rules and GC item table)

decisions: One source: no second Revit BOM schedule
Commercial data stays in the GC item table keyed by bom_item_key
Quantity basis comes only from category-rules.csv
Each category counted from one source discipline
Only purchase phases count (default New Construction)
pipeline: match rule: category + source discipline + material condition
quantity in fixed units (ft, SF, CY)
aggregate per item with level breakdown
procurement_quantity: model_quantity * (1 + waste_factor), rounded up to purchase_size in purchase_unit; computed only from a filled gc_items.csv
validation: no unique id twice in the trace
elements read = traced + exceptions; every exception has a reason
line quantity = sum of its trace
lines with missing_required > 0 listed for the owning discipline
every exported category has a rule or a deliberate exception reason
rules marked proposed are not used for buyout until confirmed
